arxiv-2104-12882.title: Random subcomplexes and Betti numbers of random edge ideals
arxiv-2104-12882.creator: Anton Dochtermann, Andrew Newman
arxiv-2104-12882.description: Abstract . We study homological properties of random quadratic monomial ideals in a polynomial ring R = 𝕂 ⁡ [ x 1 , … ​ x n ] R=\mathbb{K}[x_{1},\dots x_{n}] , utilizing methods from the Erdős–Rényi model of random graphs.

arxiv-2201-11629.title: Asteroseismology across the HR diagram Journal: Xxxx. Xxx. Xxx. Xxx. DOI: 10.1146/((please add article doi))
arxiv-2201-11629.creator: Donald Kurtz 1,2
arxiv-2201-11629.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Donald Kurtz 1,2. Asteroseismology has grown from its beginnings three decades ago to a mature field teeming with discoveries and applications. This phenomenal growth has been enabled by space photometry with precision 10 − 100 10-100 times better than ground-based observations, with nearly continuous light curves for durations of weeks to years, and by large scale ground-based surveys spanning years designed to detect all time-variable phenomena. The new high precision data are full of surprises, deepening our understanding of the physics of stars.

arxiv-2305-18919.title: A sharp interface approach for wetting dynamics of hydrophobic coated droplets and soft particles
arxiv-2305-18919.creator: Francesca Pelusi 1,‡, Fabio Guglietta 1,§, Marcello Sega 2, Othmane Aouane 1, Jens Harting 1,3
arxiv-2305-18919.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Francesca Pelusi 1,‡, Fabio Guglietta 1,§, Marcello Sega 2, Othmane Aouane 1, Jens Harting 1,3. The wetting dynamics of liquid particles, from coated droplets to soft capsules, holds significant technological interest. Motivated by the need to simulate liquid metal droplet with an oxidize surface layer, in this work we introduce a computational scheme that allows to simulate droplet dynamics with general surface properties and model different levels of interface stiffness, describing also cases that are intermediate between pure droplets and capsules.

arxiv-2401-13214.title: AMANet: Advancing SAR Ship Detection with Adaptive Multi-Hierarchical Attention Network
arxiv-2401-13214.creator: XIAOLIN MA 1, JUNKAI CHENG 2, AIHUA LI* 1, YUHUA ZHANG 1, ZHILONG LIN* 1
arxiv-2401-13214.description: Abstract Recently, methods based on deep learning have been successfully applied to ship detection for synthetic aperture radar (SAR) images. Despite the development of numerous ship detection methodologies, detecting small and coastal ships remains a significant challenge due to the limited features and clutter in coastal environments.

arxiv-2406-18090.title: Probing the superconducting gap structure of ScRuSi via μ \mu SR and first-principles calculations
arxiv-2406-18090.creator: K. Panda, A. Bhattacharyya, P. N. Ferreira, Rajib Mondal, A Thamizhavel, D. T. Adroja, C. Heil, L. T. F. Eleno, A. D. Hillier
arxiv-2406-18090.description: Abstract In this study, we present a thorough investigation into the superconducting state of the ruthenium-based ternary equiatomic compound ScRuSi. Our analysis combines experimental techniques, including muon spin rotation/relaxation ( μ \mu SR) and low-temperature resistivity measurements, with theoretical insights derived from first-principles calculations.

arxiv-2509-21229.title: Inner approximations of doubling weights with applications to Beurling-Malliavin theory in Toeplitz kernels
arxiv-2509-21229.creator: Alex Bergman
arxiv-2509-21229.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Alex Bergman. Let f f be a strictly increasing smooth function, such that f ′ f^{\prime} is comparable to a weight α ′ \alpha^{\prime} which is locally doubling and satisfies a non-triviality condition to be explained in the paper. We construct a meromorphic inner function J J , such that f − arg ⁡ ( J ) f-\arg(J) is bounded and arg ⁡ ( J ) ′ \arg(J)^{\prime} is comparable to α ′ \alpha^{\prime} up to polynomial loss.

arxiv-2512-00619.title: Neuroscience-Inspired Memory Replay for Continual Learning: A Comparative Study of Predictive Coding and Backpropagation-Based Strategies
arxiv-2512-00619.creator: Goutham Nalagatla, [0.5em] Shreyas Grandhe
arxiv-2512-00619.description: Abstract Continual learning remains a fundamental challenge in artificial intelligence, with catastrophic forgetting posing a significant barrier to deploying neural networks in dynamic environments. Inspired by biological memory consolidation mechanisms, we propose a novel framework for generative replay that leverages predictive coding principles to mitigate forgetting.

pmc-10568687.title: High-Efficiency Adsorption of Cr(VI) and Mn(VII) from Wastewater by a Two-Dimensional Copper-Based Metal–Organic Framework
pmc-10568687.creator: Yongmou Zeng, Xia Li, Yuhuan Chen, Shixiong Li
pmc-10568687.description: Cr(VI) and Mn(VII) in industrial wastewater have certain toxicity, and they pose a threat to the environment and human health and safety. Metal–organic frameworks (MOFs) usually have rich adsorption sites and a large specific surface area. They can effectively adsorb Cr(VI) and Mn(VII) from wastewater. In this paper, a two-dimensional copper-based metal–organic framework, {[Cu·(4,4′-bpy)2·(H2O)]·2(NO3)·6(H2O)·(CH3OH)}n (1), is synthesized by hydrothermal synthesis.

pmc-11332795.title: Safety and activity of lenalidomide in combination with obinutuzumab in patients with relapsed indolent non-Hodgkin lymphoma: a single group, open-label, phase 1/2 trial
pmc-11332795.creator: Ashwath Gurumurthi, Collin K Chin, Lei Feng, Nathan H Fowler, Paolo Strati, Fredrick B Hagemeister, Luis E Fayad, Jason R Westin, Chizobam Obi, Janine Arafat, Ranjit Nair, Raphael E Steiner, Sattva S Neelapu, Christopher R Flowers, Loretta J Nastoupil
pmc-11332795.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). SummaryBackgroundRituximab and lenalidomide is a preferred option for relapsed indolent B cell non-Hodgkin lymphoma. Obinutuzumab may be a superior combination partner with lenalidomide given enhanced antibody dependent cellular cytotoxicity and phagocytosis compared to rituximab.

pmc-11597183.title: Computational Analysis of S1PR1 SNPs Reveals Drug Binding Modes Relevant to Multiple Sclerosis Treatment
pmc-11597183.creator: Katarina Kores, Samo Lešnik, Urban Bren, Cristina Manuela Dragoi, Alina Crenguța Nicolae, Ion-Bogdan Dumitrescu
pmc-11597183.description: Background/Objectives: Multiple sclerosis (MS) is an autoimmune disorder of the central nervous system (CNS) characterized by myelin and axonal damage with a globally rising incidence. While there is no known cure for MS, various disease-modifying treatments (DMTs) exist, including those targeting Sphingosine-1-Phosphate Receptors (S1PRs), which play important roles in immune response, CNS function, and cardiovascular regulation.

pmc-12471730.title: Incidence of Uterine Cesarean Scar Niche After Cesarean Delivery and Assessment of Its Risk Factors
pmc-12471730.creator: Ahmed Khedr Khalifa, Ahmed Adel Yasseen Abdel Moteleb, Marwa O. Elgendy, Ahmed Abdel Khalek Taha, Eman A. Salem, Ahmed R. N. Ibrahim, Sara Abdallah Mohamed Salem, Eman Zein Elabein Farid, Waleed Mohammed Elamin Khaled
pmc-12471730.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Background and Objectives: A cesarean scar defect (CSD), also referred to as a niche or isthmocele, is often detected incidentally during transvaginal sonography (TVS) and is typically asymptomatic. However, the exact prevalence of symptomatic niches remains unclear. This study aimed to evaluate the incidence of cesarean scar niches and identify potential risk factors in a prospectively gathered cohort of Egyptian women.

pmc-12595072.title: Effects of multisensory packaging on taste perception, emotional responses, and willingness to pay for chocolate
pmc-12595072.creator: Shuangshuang Xiao, LiYang Yu, Yuwen Meng, Roope Raisamo, Mounia Ziat
pmc-12595072.description: Product packaging serves as a powerful multisensory cue that shapes consumer expectations, emotional responses, and purchasing behavior–often before the product is even consumed. This study investigated how color, texture, scent, and unboxing interaction jointly influence the perceived quality, taste experience, emotional engagement, and economic valuation of a chocolate product.

pmc-12618931.title: Correlation of peripheral blood eosinophil counts with atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease: a cross-sectional study
pmc-12618931.creator: Runze Chang, Chuanlong Lu, Ruijing Zhang, Honglin Dong
pmc-12618931.description: Atherosclerotic cardiovascular diseases (ASCVD) are a group of diseases that can lead to serious lethal and disabling consequences, in which inflammation plays a key role. Although the role of eosinophils as innate immune cells in cardiovascular disease has been extensively studied, their specific impact is unclear and conflicting findings exist.

pmc-12621467.title: Lesion Network Mapping of Acute Neurological Deficits and Its Prognostic Value After Ischemic Stroke
pmc-12621467.creator: Aslı Akdeniz, Ana Sofía Ríos, Uchralt Temuulen, Jochen B. Fiebach, Kersten Villringer, Huma Fatima Ali, Ahmed Khalil, Ulrike Grittner, Thomas Liman, Matthias Endres, Anna Kufner
pmc-12621467.description: Graphical abstract Introduction Ischemic stroke, which accounts for nearly 70 % of all strokes worldwide, is a leading cause of long-term disability and reduced quality of life (Gbd, 2021). Accurately predicting stroke outcomes and functional dependency is critical for optimizing recovery strategies and tailoring rehabilitation approaches (Goyal et al., 2021).

pmc-12641704.title: Music Sound Quality Assessment in Bimodal Cochlear Implant Users—Toward Improved Hearing Aid Fitting
pmc-12641704.creator: Khaled H. A. Abdellatif, Horst Hessel, Moritz Wächtler, Verena Müller, Martin Walger, Hartmut Meister
pmc-12641704.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Background/Objectives: Cochlear implants (CIs) are a common treatment of severe-to-profound hearing loss and provide reasonable speech understanding, at least in quiet situations. However, their limited spectro-temporal resolution restricts sound quality, which is especially crucial for music appraisal. Many CI recipients wear a hearing aid (HA) on the non-implanted ear (bimodal users), which may enhance music perception by adding acoustic fine structure cues.

pmc-12815475.title: TLR4 rs4986790 and TLR9 rs5743836 Polymorphisms and Their Association With Clinical Outcomes of Leishmania infantum Infection in Tunisia
pmc-12815475.creator: Najla Chargui, Nabil Mtiraoui, Raja Chaabane Banaoues, Hamouda Babba, Wahiba Sakly
pmc-12815475.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Background: The clinical presentation of Leishmania infantum infection ranges from self-resolving cutaneous leishmaniasis (CL) to visceral leishmaniasis (VL). Host genetic factors, particularly polymorphisms in Toll-like receptor (TLR) genes, are suspected to influence disease variability and outcome. This study aimed to investigate the potential association between two specific single-nucleotide polymorphisms (SNPs) in the TLR4 (rs4986790) and TLR9 (rs5743836) genes and susceptibility to different clinical forms of L.

pmc-13003671.title: Citizen science provides insights on pollination services in urban community gardens
pmc-13003671.creator: Susan Karlebowski, Monika Egerer, Astrid E Neumann, Julia M Schmack, Aaron N Sexton, Ulrike Sturm
pmc-13003671.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundUrban community gardens are collectively managed (agro)ecosystems shaped by diverse gardening practices that influence both planned and associated biodiversity. Yet, biodiversity-mediated ecosystem services in these gardens remain underexplored, and gardeners are rarely engaged as collaborators in scientific research. In this study, we investigated how bee diversity and urbanization factors affect pollination services, measured by the fruit set of common garden crops under real-world gardening conditions.

pmc-13356522.title: Distinct Patterns of Colorectal Peritoneal Metastases at Initial and Repeat Cytoreductive Surgery
pmc-13356522.creator: Mina Sarofim, David L Morris
pmc-13356522.description: Colorectal cancer rates are continually increasing in Western countries exceeding over 3 million new cases annually. Hematogenous spread to the liver is the most common metastatic route, followed by transcoelomic dissemination to the peritoneum. Colorectal peritoneal metastases (CRPM) affect 5%–8% at the time of initial diagnosis and a further 10%–20% who develop recurrence.

pmc-13397640.title: Endoscopic variceal ligation-induced ulcer bleeding: incidence by indication, real-world treatment, and outcomes
pmc-13397640.creator: Thomas Vasilakis, Simon Schauer, Donata Grajecki, Alexander Wree, Christian Jürgensen, Frank Tacke, Cornelius Engelmann

pmc-13434628.title: Educational and programmatic components of effective school-based food and nutrition education: an umbrella review
pmc-13434628.creator: Natalie H Greaves-Peters, Pamela Ann Koch, Randi Wolf, Jennifer W Cadenhead
pmc-13434628.description: Objective:To identify and synthesise the educational and programmatic components most consistently associated with effective school-based food and nutrition education (SBFNE) for children and adolescents.Design:An umbrella review was conducted in accordance with PRISMA 2020 guidelines. We systematically searched CLEO, EDUCAT+, PubMed and Google Scholar through December 2022 for eligible literature reviews and meta-analyses.

uslaw-usc-t36-s30302.title: 36 U.S.C. § 30302 — Purposes
uslaw-usc-t36-s30302.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t36-s30302.description: United States Code, Title 36 (Patriotic And National Observances, Ceremonies, And Organizations); Part B (Organizations); Chapter 303 (Blinded Veterans Association). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. The purposes of the corporation are— (1) to operate as a not-for-profit corporation exclusively for charitable, educational, patriotic, and civic improvement purposes; (2) to promote the welfare of blinded veterans so that, notwithstanding their disabilities, they may.
